name: Pizzeria Alpina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Alpina in Pfronten**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Alpina** in the heart of **Pfronten**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short stroll from the **Zugspitze**, our cozy pizzeria offers freshly baked pizzas with the finest local ingredients—think crispy **Tiroler Speck**, creamy **Käse** from the region, and fresh mountain herbs.

Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a unique creation like our **Alpina Special** with wild mushrooms and **Tiroler Bergkäse**, every slice is made with passion. Pair your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp white wine from nearby vineyards.

After dinner, take a moment to enjoy the breathtaking views of the **Allgäu** Alps or the twinkling lights of **Innsbruck** in the distance. **Pizzeria Alpina**—where good food and mountain magic come together.
